scope: All 108 names: the text was compared name by name with the page images of the TTD book (pp. 39–41), and every meaning was read against its name. There are no word-by-word glosses on this page (the meanings are per name). The range-number flags are the block labels. The meanings were all sound.

items.issue: Names 42 and 43 stood as sāmapriyāya, sarvamayāya; the print has them in the order sarvamayāya, sāmapriyāya.
